reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and a named lab report for the exact batch is more than I get from most brands. At $24.99 I would try one box, but I would not commit to more before I see if I feel anything.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put 8 forms in one capsule? Also 2 capsules a day for 200 mg feels like a lot of capsules for one form.
would_change_my_mind: A clear note on why bisglycinate alone is enough, or my doctor saying that form is fine for me.
